{{Top|leg}}
'''Service bays''' were used to maintain and service [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Pellezara station]], a stopover point for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]], featured free-floating service bays.
